pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on sequential order stacking within a 50-point window unless the initial trade has secured at least +$3.00 in floating profit and moved to break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution permitted without an ATR-normalized volatility filter and confirmation of order book imbalance away from high-impact liquidity pools.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing profit harvest once a trade achieves +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric win profiles ($15-$30+).
